gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced/unresectable or metastatic solid tumor that is relapsed/refractory after standard therapy, or no standard therapy available.

candidate_evidence.quote: This Phase 1/2 study evaluates the safety, feasibility, and preliminary anti-tumor activity of allogeneic donor-derived CAR-NK cells in participants with advanced solid tumors.
Participants receive lymphodepleting chemotherapy followed by CAR-NK infusion(s).
Optional cytokine support (e.g., low-dose IL-2) may be used per protocol to support NK persistence, consistent with approaches used in some CAR-NK studies.

coder_notes: Multi-cancer CAR-NK basket; Glioblastoma named in conditions. Ages field includes CHILD although inclusion says 18-75. Only CAR-NK cell products are investigational (excluded type). Fludarabine/cyclophosphamide are conditioning (supportive, R6). Antigen positivity (including EGFR, one of nine menu antigens) is an entry requirement and also determines arm assignment (1 vs >=2 antigens); not candidate-matched because the CAR-NK products are not candidates. Not coded as EGFR_EGFRvIII because the requirement is any menu antigen.
